title: Quietly Broiled Peruvian Sweet Potatoes Chupe De Camarones
description: A buttery and springy Peruvian dish featuring sweet potatoes, perfect for a post-workout meal, served in an earthenware bowl in the style of Chupe De Camarones, this keto-friendly recipe is a great way to refuel.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sweet potatoes with 1 tablespoon of butter, salt, black pepper, and paprika until they are evenly coated.
Spread the sweet potatoes out in a single layer on a baking sheet and broil for 20 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
While the sweet potatoes are cooking, melt the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, or until fragrant.
Add the shrimp to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until they are pink and cooked through.
Stir in the lime juice and cook for an additional 1 minute.
To serve, divide the sweet potatoes among four earthenware bowls, then top with the shrimp and garlic mixture.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve immediately.
